lines.text: Previously. I made it to Ashford, and the Guild's magic cube called me an error.
A girl with my hair beat me in a duel, because my axe refuses to block.
Haruki was here. Two years ago. He got into a golden carriage and waved.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee was here. Two years ago. He got into a golden carriage and waved.

lines.text: And to follow him, I have to become a Hunter.
You're sharpening an axe that can cut through anything.
It calms me down.
You're nervous.
I've never taken an exam where failing means dying.
Mm. It's just like school, except the teacher is a desert.
Did you take it?
Three times. I died twice.
That's not comforting.
The third time I slept through the Fiend attack and woke up with a license. Some people are lucky.
You're making that up.
...A little.
Rin's good, you know. She's mean because she's scared of losing people. That's all.
I know. I've met that kind of person before.
In a mirror?
Go to sleep, Nemu.
lines.tts: Go to sleep, Neh-moo.

lines.text: Applicants! Welcome to the Bramble Wastes. Your exam is simple.
Somewhere in that canyon is a Fiend core, marked with a Guild flag. Bring it back by sunset tomorrow.
Lesser Fiends only in the exam zone. If you meet anything bigger, fire your flare and run.
What if we can't run?
Then you fail. Permanently.
Don't slow me down.
Don't tie me to a rock.
Don't give me ideas.
Good luck. Come back with all your limbs.
That's the bar?
It's a high bar, out here.
Rin. Watch his left side. He never watches it.
Why would I watch his anything?
Because if he dies, you fail too.
...Fine. Left side.
So. Rin Ashveil.
lines.tts: So. Rin Ash-vale.

lines.text: Don't.
I haven't said anything.
You were going to say something about the hair.
I was going to say we should talk about a plan.
And also the hair.
I knew it.
Plan. You tie things up. I break things. We don't break each other.
That's not a plan. That's a list of hobbies.
It's more of a plan than you had.
My plan was to leave you at the entrance.
See? That one's worse.
Stop. Brambles. Don't touch them, the thorns are poisoned.
Everything here is poisoned or wants to eat me.
Welcome to the March.
Can't I just break them?
You can break one. There are ten thousand.
I can break ten thousand.
Slowly. While the Lesser Fiends hear you and come for lunch.
...We go around.
We go around.
Stop. Something's moving behind the rocks.
Not again.
A Shieldbearer. A lone one. Lesser class.
I broke one of these on my first day.
Then this is your second day. Go left, I'll bind it from the right.
Your LEFT!
You said go left! I went left!
MY left!
How was I supposed to know that?!
Fine! Your left, my right! Count of three! One...
Two!
Three!
...Huh. That worked.
Don't sound so surprised.
I'm surprised it worked with YOU.
Boo!
AAH!
Fiend!
Whoa whoa whoa! Not a Fiend! Human! Mostly human! Applicant number forty-four!
Your head is on fire.
It's always on fire! It's my Brand! It doesn't hurt! Please put the knife down!
Rin.
...Fine.
Thank you. Hiro Aoyama. Everyone calls me Wick, for obvious reasons.
lines.tts: Thank you. Hiro Ah-oh-yah-mah. Everyone calls me Wick, for obvious reasons.

lines.text: Hiro Aoyama? That's a Japanese name.
lines.tts: Hiro Ah-oh-yah-mah? That's a Japanese name.

lines.text: Wait. You said Japanese. Nobody here says Japanese.
Kirishima Takuto. Nerima. Tokyo.
lines.tts: Kee-ree-shee-mah Tah-koo-toh. Neh-ree-mah. Tokyo.

lines.text: No way. NO WAY. Osaka! I'm from Osaka! Tennoji! You're Skyfallen!
lines.tts: No way. NO WAY. Oh-sah-kah! I'm from Oh-sah-kah! Ten-noh-jee! You're Skyfallen!

lines.text: You too?
Three years! Three years, and you're the first person who knows what a convenience store is!
I miss the onigiri.
lines.tts: I miss the oh-nee-gee-ree.

lines.text: The tuna mayo ones!
The tuna mayo ones.
I don't know what either of you are talking about, and I hate it.
Where's your partner?
Mine ran away when my head caught fire this morning. Again. Third partner this year.
You can come with us.
He can NOT.
He knows about tuna mayo.
That is not a combat skill!
I can also light campfires! And see in the dark! And I'm very cheap to feed!
...We leave him behind the moment he slows us down.
Deal! I'm very fast when I'm scared, and I'm always scared!
Okay. So. Before anything happens. I should mention I have never actually fought a Fiend.
You have been here three years.
And I have been running for three years! Very successfully!
Something is standing in the path.
Another Shieldbearer. Fine. Same as before. Takuto, the shield. I take the legs.
lines.tts: Another Shieldbearer. Fine. Same as before. Tah-koo-toh, the shield. I take the legs.

lines.text: And me? What do I take?
Cover.
Break.
Why is it coming for ME?!
Because you are the one screaming!
Fine! FINE! Will-o'-Wisp!
Only the bones! Burn only the bones!
Red Thread!
Ruinbreaker.
I did it. I fought a Fiend. I fought a Fiend and I did not run away!
You did good.
You burned my scarf.
Only a little! It only burns what I tell it to! I told it the bones and the scarf was near the bones!
...It's fine. My brother burned it worse once.
So how'd you fall through?
Railway crossing. Two in the morning. The sky cracked.
Mine was a shrine. I was buying a charm for exams. The ground opened under the gate.
Funny, right? I was buying a charm to pass exams, and now I'm taking one in a desert full of monsters.
...Three years.
Three years.
Have you looked for a way back?
Everybody looks. The first year, I looked every day. Rifts, old books, fortune tellers.
I met an old man in Fort Cinder who fell through forty years ago. Forty. He has a family here now.
He told me the same thing everyone tells you, eventually.
What?
Nobody goes home. Not one. Not ever. The Rifts only open one way.
Sorry. I always say it too fast. My mom used to say I had no brakes.
Somebody fell through at my crossing two years ago. My friend.
Then you're not looking for a way home. You're looking for him.
Yeah.
That's a better thing to look for. That one, you can find.
There. The flag. The core is at the bottom of the canyon.
We camp here and climb down at first light.
Why not now?
Because things in the Wastes hunt by sound at night, and you two never stop talking.
She's got us there.
And then the vending machine ate my coin, so I kicked it, and the security guard...
Anyway, he never caught me. I was the fastest kid in Tennoji. Still am. Fear is a great coach.
lines.tts: Anyway, he never caught me. I was the fastest kid in Ten-noh-jee. Still am. Fear is a great coach.

lines.text: Do you miss it? Osaka?
lines.tts: Do you miss it? Oh-sah-kah?

lines.text: Every day. My mom ran a little okonomiyaki shop. Four tables. I used to flip the pancakes when she was tired.
Sometimes I make them here. No flour that tastes right. No sauce. They're terrible.
I make them anyway. So I don't forget the smell.
Make me one sometime.
They're really bad.
I'll eat it anyway.
...Okay. Okay! Deal! I knew I liked you.
He's asleep.
He fell asleep in the middle of his own story.
His head is still on fire. Is that safe?
It kept us warm.
...It did.
Nemu told me about your brother.
lines.tts: Neh-moo told me about your brother.

lines.text: Nemu has a big mouth for someone who sleeps all day.
lines.tts: Neh-moo has a big mouth for someone who sleeps all day.

lines.text: I'm sorry.
Don't be sorry. Be useful. That's what he would have said.
He used to say a Hunter is just a person who stands between a Fiend and someone who can't run.
That's a good thing to be.
It got him killed.
It saved somebody first, though. Didn't it?
...A whole caravan. Eleven people.
Then he was right.
Why do you even want this? You could stay in Ashford, sweep floors, live a quiet life.
Because the axe came out for me. That has to be for something.
It was for something, boy. For me.
You do that a lot. Go quiet and look at the axe.
It talks.
Very funny.
...Yeah. Very funny.
Wh-what was that?
The ground. Something under the ground.
That is NOT a Lesser Fiend!
A Stonehide Behemoth. A Greater Fiend. In the exam zone.
The examiner said fire the flare and run.
It's between us and the canyon exit.
So we fire the flare and run... somewhere else?
Move!
Its skin is rock. Swords won't cut it.
Swords won't. You might.
You're trusting me?
I'm trusting the axe. Don't make it weird.
Break!
He cracked it! He cracked the rock!
Takuto!
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh!

lines.text: I'm fine. I tried to block again.
Stop trying to block!
Red Thread! Its legs are bound! Wick, its eyes!
Will-o'-Wisp! Only burns what I tell it to! Burn its eyes!
It can't see and it can't move! Now, Takuto!
lines.tts: It can't see and it can't move! Now, Tah-koo-toh!

lines.text: Ah. Finally, something worth breaking.
Ruinbreaker!
We're alive. We're ALIVE!
Mostly.
You're bleeding.
You're worried.
I'm calculating whether I pass if my partner bleeds to death.
And?
Don't bleed to death.
Rin. That's the nicest thing you've ever said.
Nobody asked you, fire boy.
Applicants! We saw the flare... you didn't fire it. We saw the explosion.
Is that... a Stonehide Behemoth? You killed a Greater Fiend? You're applicants!
It was in the way.
He says that.
Greater Fiends don't come into the exam zone. We clear it every season. Something drove this one here.
Drove it? Fiends don't take orders.
They don't. That's what worries me.
You pass. All three of you. Hunters, rank F, effective immediately. Congratulations.
Rank F! I'm a real Hunter! Mom! I'm a Hunter!
Rank F. For killing a Greater Fiend.
Everyone starts at F. Even my brother.
...You're not completely useless, Skyfallen.
That's the nicest thing you've ever said.
Don't get used to it.
Wick. How did your Brand wake up?
You really want to know? It is not a cool story.
Mine was a girl dying in a graveyard. Mine is not a cool story either.
My first winter here, I got lost in the Wastes. No coat. Just my hoodie. Three days.
On the third night, I couldn't feel my hands. I lay down in the sand and I thought, okay. This is it. I just want to be warm one more time.
And then I was. My whole head went up like a gas stove. Blue. I could see for a mile.
You wanted to be warm.
A Brand is what you want most, at the moment you are about to die. That is what Valentine told me.
I wanted to be warm. You wanted... what did you want?
...To break the thing that was killing her.
Huh. Yeah. That tracks.
Mine was a thread. I wanted to hold on to something that was falling.
...Okay, so that is the saddest one. Rin wins.
It is not a contest, Wick.
Everything is a contest when you are rank F.
Welcome back. I made a sign.
It says welcome back, hunter's. With an apostrophe.
I ran out of paint for the rest of the plural.
You made us a sign? Nobody has ever made me a sign!
I didn't make it for you. Who are you? Your head is on fire.
Hiro Aoyama! Osaka! Hunter, rank F! Everyone calls me Wick!
lines.tts: Hiro Ah-oh-yah-mah! Oh-sah-kah! Hunter, rank F! Everyone calls me Wick!

lines.text: ...You can stand under the sign too. It is a big sign.
Did you wait here the whole time?
I slept here the whole time. Waiting is just sleeping where people can see you.
Thanks, Nemu.
lines.tts: Thanks, Neh-moo.

lines.text: Mm. You smell like rocks. Take a bath before the ceremony.
Three applicants. One Greater Fiend. Zero dead. I may cry.
She cried at the last ceremony too.
That was allergies!
Kirishima Takuto, Hunter rank F. Rin Ashveil, Hunter rank C, commended. Hiro Aoyama, Hunter rank F.
lines.tts: Kee-ree-shee-mah Tah-koo-toh, Hunter rank F. Rin Ash-vale, Hunter rank C, commended. Hiro Ah-oh-yah-mah, Hunter rank F.

lines.text: Commended?
For keeping two Skyfallen alive in the Wastes. That is harder than killing a Behemoth, darling.
Hey!
She's not wrong.
Takuto. The examiner's report says something drove that Behemoth into the zone.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. The examiner's report says something drove that Behemoth into the zone.

lines.text: The axe said the same thing.
...The axe said.
Forget it.
No. I won't. Next time it says something, you tell me.
And bring Tofu a present. He sulked for two days after the error.
Two Skyfallen on one license list. In one season. That has never happened, Sieg.
lines.tts: Two Skyfallen on one license list. In one season. That has never happened, Seeg.

lines.text: Wick has been here three years. That only leaves one new one.
Do you know what the Guild does with its Skyfallen reports? It sends them to Saint Lumen. Sealed. And nothing comes back.
Nothing ever?
Once. A boy with black hair, two winters ago. The Order sent a golden carriage for him personally.
Haruki. Takuto's friend.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee. Tah-koo-toh's friend.

lines.text: If the Saint sends a carriage for Takuto too, I want to know why before he gets in.
lines.tts: If the Saint sends a carriage for Tah-koo-toh too, I want to know why before he gets in.

lines.text: He would get in. To see his friend, he would get into anything.
Then we had better make him strong enough to get out again.
Gideon.
Gideon. I'll write to him tonight. He loves a hopeless project.
Rank F. Look at you.
The clerk drew a star on mine.
And a little crown.
Valentine made her.
Hey, Takuto. When you find your friend... can I come?
lines.tts: Hey, Tah-koo-toh. When you find your friend... can I come?

lines.text: Why?
Because I want to see somebody get what they're looking for. Just once. It'd be nice.
...Yeah. You can come.
Hm. You're collecting strays.
Says the girl I found on the train tracks.
I found you.
Something herded that beast to you, boy. Something that knows exactly what I am.
...Who?
Someone who smells like static.
It broke a Behemoth on his third day.
...Faster than I hoped. Let's give the Guild something to worry about.
Next time: the Guild's artificer builds me a chain harness.
It lets my axe block exactly once. Once.
Then somebody sets the forge on fire, and a man in a black suit is smiling in the smoke.
Episode four. Cogwheel Heart.
